posts.name: ComicJock
posts.cooked: I ordered Shattered Timelines and a bunch of the mini-expansions from Greater Than Games' website about a week ago.  My order has since not moved from the status of payment recieved.  Since I bought most of my other Sentinels products from Amazon I really have no idea what to expect in terms of time line for this order.  So I guess I am just trying to find out at what point should I start wondering if something has gone wrong?  I am not really worried yet I realize it's a smaller company dealing with a crazy rush.  I just don't want to be that guy who freaks too early and annoys people.  I also don't want to be the guy who freaks too late and then it's a complicated mess to straighten out his order because stuff has fallen off the system.  (I have worked in a warehouse before and I have seen both happen.)
